parameters.description:
`misskey-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `misskey` payload that includes your credential field, and the gateway forwards it to your upstream Misskey instance, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel relays your own authenticated payload; the `plus` channel is the metered tier.
parameters.summary: Relay a note to your own Misskey account by posting a native Misskey payload to the UnitySVC gateway.
